purpose: Prospective public-web re-observation of a number present in an earlier TuLotero snapshot; inventory evidence only, never draw-probability evidence.

observations.interpretation: No disappearance event observed for 29600 between the earlier snapshot and this public re-observation. This is not evidence that 29600 is more or less likely to be drawn.

networkCountQuarantine.reason: TuLotero public pages currently expose inconsistent network-size claims (for example >1000 and >4000). Do not use these counts as exposure denominators until definitions are reconciled.
